description: This file defines the RedirectMain activity class, which serves as an entry point for a redirection example in an Android app. It manages UI interactions, preference loading, and activity result handling related to redirecting and inputting text.

classes.name: RedirectMain
classes.description: An Activity class providing UI for a redirect example, handling button clicks to clear or set new text preferences, and managing activity results.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initialize the activity, set layout, and setup button click listeners. Requests user input if preferences are not set.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handle results from activities to either load preferences or finish activity based on user interactions.

methods.name: loadPrefs
methods.description: Load text preference and update UI; returns true if successful.
